cues.text: When you have handed the contract and the knife back to the man,
his face disappears behind the hatch for a moment.
After a few seconds you hear the door being unlocked from inside.
"Come in!", says the man as he opens the door and
leads you into a small but very cosy room with a fireplace.
He introduces himself as "Mylgor,
alchemist" and right away shows you the room where you are to spend the night.
When you ask where he is going to sleep, if not there, he laughs heartily:
"Do you really think this little hut is big enough to live in for a scientist like me?
No, no: this is only the room where my servant usually sleeps -
he is running some errands for me in the next village at the moment.
My laboratory and the other rooms are...
- hidden!
It doesn't matter where..."
Mylgor nervously strokes his goatee, but then forces himself back into his peculiar smile.
"But I thought we wanted to talk about you -
not about me...?", he says, nodding towards the fireplace room,
"Let's chat for an hour by the warm fire,
and maybe I'll tell you a little about the history of our village.
But first give me your wet things - otherwise you might catch your death...!"
With a very queasy feeling in your stomach, you undress,
keeping a close eye on the old alchemist all the time:
who knows what kind of favour you are supposed to do for the old man?
Wasn't there a greedy gleam in his eyes just now?
To be safe, you glance at the door of your room: thank God!
It can be locked!
Embarrassed and unsure, you hand Mylgor your damp swimming trunks -
but all he does is lay them by the fire to dry...
